note: Researched bookmaker listing receipts for fixtures the automated ladder cannot price (session 2e920ea8, 2026-10-16). Each receipt is a dated observation of a two-way decimal book line from a named listing page, verified against the board row's exact opponent pair, UTC start and Hotspawn fixture id before publication. Probabilities are never hand-entered: scripts.core.quote_book re-derives them by de-vig on every build and the validator replays the same math. Placeholder rows (identical default odds such as 1.8/1.8) are deliberately NOT recorded here; they are documented as rejected in research/fallback-2e920ea8/README.md. Evidence window is the standard 8 hours (scripts.core.MAX_AGE); after it lapses a row reverts to the research-only tier until a listed line is re-observed.
